description: This file manages database connections and session handling for a project, supporting both PostgreSQL and SQLite backends. It includes functions for initializing, closing, and health-checking database connections, and provides a FastAPI dependency for async database sessions.

methods.name: get_database_url
methods.description: Determines the database URL and type based on environment variables, defaulting to SQLite if none are set.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Asynchronous FastAPI dependency that provides a database session, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: init_database
methods.description: Initializes database resources; creates tables for SQLite.

methods.name: check_database_connection
methods.description: Performs a simple query to verify database connectivity.

methods.name: get_database_health
methods.description: Returns the health status of the database connection.
